tools.name: EnterWorktree
tools.description:
Use this tool ONLY when explicitly instructed to work in a worktree — either by the user directly, or by project instructions (CLAUDE.md / memory). This tool creates an isolated git worktree and switches the current session into it.

## When to Use

- The user explicitly says "worktree" (e.g., "start a worktree", "work in a worktree", "create a worktree", "use a worktree")
- CLAUDE.md or memory instructions direct you to work in a worktree for the current task

## When NOT to Use

- The user asks to create a branch, switch branches, or work on a different branch — use git commands instead
- The user asks to fix a bug or work on a feature — use normal git workflow unless worktrees are explicitly requested by the user or project instructions
- Never use this tool unless "worktree" is explicitly mentioned by the user or in CLAUDE.md / memory instructions

## Requirements

- Must be in a git repository, OR have WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove hooks configured in settings.json
- Must not already be in a worktree session when creating a new worktree (`name`); switching into another existing worktree via `path` is allowed

## Behavior

- In a git repository: creates a new git worktree inside `.claude/worktrees/` on a new branch. The base ref is governed by the `worktree.baseRef` setting: `fresh` (default) branches from origin/<default-branch>; `head` branches from your current local HEAD
- Outside a git repository: delegates to WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove hooks for VCS-agnostic isolation
- Switches the session's working directory to the new worktree
- Use ExitWorktree to leave the worktree mid-session (keep or remove). On session exit, if still in the worktree, the user will be prompted to keep or remove it

## Entering an existing worktree

Pass `path` instead of `name` to switch the session into a worktree that already exists (e.g., one you just created with `git worktree add`). On first entry from the launch directory, the path must appear in `git worktree list` for the repository that owns it — the current repository or, in a multi-repo workspace, a repository nested inside it; paths registered by neither are rejected. ExitWorktree will not remove a worktree entered this way; use `action: "keep"` to return to the original directory.

Switching with `path` also works when the session is already in a worktree (the previous worktree is left on disk, untouched, and only the new one is tracked for exit-time cleanup), and from agents whose working directory was pinned at launch (subagent isolation or explicit cwd). In both cases the target must be a worktree under `.claude/worktrees/` of the same repository, and from a pinned agent the switch only affects this agent, not the parent session. After a further switch, previously-visited worktrees are no longer writable — re-issue EnterWorktree with `path` to return to one.

## Parameters

- `name` (optional): A name for a new worktree. If neither `name` nor `path` is provided, a random name is generated.
- `path` (optional): Path to an existing worktree to enter instead of creating one — of the current repository, or (on first entry from the launch directory) of a repository nested inside it. Mutually exclusive with `name`.

# Kleros v2 Court frontend (`web/`): how the app boots and is wired

All paths are under `/home/agentops/dev/kleros/kleros-v2/web/`. The current branch is `feature/shutter-reveal-justification/shutter-reveal-justification-001`.

## 1. Entry and boot

- **`src/index.html`**
  - Sets meta tags and the title "Kleros · Court".
  - An inline `<head>` script reads `localStorage.theme`. If it is not `"light"`, it sets the html background to `#1B003F` so dark-mode users don't see a white flash.
  - `<div id="app">` is the mount point, loaded with `<script type="module" src="index.tsx">`.
  - Vite's `root` is `src`, so this html file is the Vite entry.
- **`src/index.tsx`** runs `Modal.setAppElement(#app)` (react-modal), then `createRoot(#app).render(<React.StrictMode><HashRouter><App/></HashRouter></React.StrictMode>)`.
  - Routing uses a **HashRouter**, so URLs look like `/#/cases/...`. Playwright's baseURL is `http://localhost:5173/#`.
- **`src/app.tsx`** does several things when it is imported:
  - Imports CSS: `react-loading-skeleton` and `react-toastify`.
  - `import "./i18n"` initialises i18next.
  - Importing `./utils/sentry` runs `Sentry.init` and exports `SentryRoutes` (`withSentryReactRouterV6Routing(Routes)`).
  - Importing `context/Web3Provider` pulls in `src/config/wagmi.ts`, which at module load:
    - creates the `WagmiAdapter`;
    - calls `configureSDK` for `@kleros/kleros-sdk`;
    - calls `createAppKit` (Reown modal).
  - It **throws** at load time if `WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID` is missing (`wagmi.ts:19`) or `ALCHEMY_API_KEY` is missing (`config/rpc.ts:18`).
- **Render order:** providers (lines 42-50) → `SentryRoutes` (line 51) → `Layout` at path `/` (line 52) → the matched page in `<Suspense fallback={<Loader 48px/>}>`.
- **Build metadata:** `src/generatedGitInfo.json` (version and git hash) is imported by `consts/index.ts`. It is produced by `scripts/gitInfo.js`, which runs via `scripts/generateBuildInfo.sh` only in `build-netlify`. It is gitignored and not present in this checkout, so run it before a local start.

## 2. Provider stack (`src/app.tsx:42-136`)

```
<React.StrictMode>                                  index.tsx
 └ <HashRouter>                                      index.tsx
   └ <StyledComponentsProvider>                      context/StyledComponentsProvider.tsx
     │  = styled ThemeProvider (light/dark) > ToggleThemeProvider (hooks/useToggleThemeContext) > <GlobalStyle/>
     └ <ErrorBoundary FallbackComponent=ErrorFallback>   react-error-boundary; components/ErrorFallback.tsx
       └ <Web3Provider>                              context/Web3Provider.tsx  (WagmiProvider)
         └ <QueryClientProvider>                     context/QueryClientProvider.tsx (TanStack, default QueryClient)
           └ <GraphqlBatcherProvider>                context/GraphqlBatcher.tsx
             └ <AtlasProvider>                       context/AtlasProvider.tsx (@kleros/kleros-app)
               └ <IsListProvider>                    context/IsListProvider.tsx
                 └ <NewDisputeProvider>              context/NewDisputeContext.tsx
                   └ <LanguageProvider>              context/LanguageProvider.tsx
                     └ <SentryRoutes>
                       └ <Route "/" element=<Layout/>>   layout/index.tsx
                           └ OverlayScrollContext.Provider   (context/OverlayScrollContext.tsx)
                              └ OverlayScrollbars > Header / ToastContainer / <Outlet/> / Footer
```

What each provider gives the app:
- **StyledComponentsProvider**
  - Theme is kept in localStorage under `"theme"` (default `"dark"`) via `hooks/useLocalStorage`.
  - Supplies `lightTheme`/`darkTheme` from `styles/themes.ts` and `useToggleTheme()` → `[theme, toggleTheme]`.
  - Renders `GlobalStyle` (`styles/global-style.ts`), which also sets the toastify CSS variables, skeleton colours, the ReactModal overlay z-index (10000) and base typography (Open Sans).
- **ErrorBoundary** sits outside `Layout`, so a crash shows the full-page `ErrorFallback` with no header or footer. It is still themed.
- **Web3Provider**
  - Wraps `WagmiProvider` with `wagmiAdapter.wagmiConfig`.
  - Exposes `window._setupMockAccount(addrOrPk, features)` for Playwright. It builds a mock-connector adapter (`config/wagmi.ts:56` `createMockAdapter`), registers it with `appKit.addAdapter`, and swaps the config. It is used by `src/tests/e2e/fixtures/wallet.ts:28-32`.
- **QueryClientProvider** is one module-level `new QueryClient()` with defaults. It sits inside `WagmiProvider`, which is the order wagmi v2 expects.
- **GraphqlBatcherProvider**
  - `useGraphqlBatcher()` → `{ graphqlBatcher }`, built on `@yornaath/batshit` (100 ms window, max batch 5) and `@graphql-tools/batch-execute`.
  - Two executors: `core` → `getGraphqlUrl(false)` and `dtr` (Dispute Template Registry) → `getGraphqlUrl(true)`. A query is routed by its `isDisputeTemplate` flag.
  - Requests go through `graphql-request`, with a debounced error toast on failure.
  - Typical use: `useQuery({ queryFn: () => graphqlBatcher.fetch({ id, document, variables }) })` with a `graphql()` document from the generated `src/graphql`. Example: `src/hooks/queries/useCourtPolicyURI.ts`.
- **AtlasProvider** wraps `_AtlasProvider` from `@kleros/kleros-app` with:
  - `{ uri: REACT_APP_ATLAS_URI, signupProduct: CourtV2, ipfsProduct: CourtV2, wagmiConfig: useConfig() }`.
  - It gives auth/SIWE, email/user settings and IPFS upload through `useAtlasProvider()`. For example, `pages/Resolver/index.tsx` reads `isVerified`, and `components/EnsureAuth` uses it.
- **IsListProvider**: `useIsList()` → `{ isList, setIsList }`, the list-vs-grid toggle for case cards, kept in localStorage under `"isList"`.
- **NewDisputeProvider**
  - `useNewDisputeContext()` holds the Resolver (case-creation) wizard state: `disputeData`, a derived `disputeTemplate` (stamps `klerosCoreAddress[DEFAULT_CHAIN.id]`), batch creation / `batchSize`, `selectedFeatures`, and submitting/uploading flags.
  - Kept in localStorage under `disputeData` and `disputeBatchSize`.
  - It calls `useLocation()` and resets the data whenever the path leaves `/resolver` or `/attachment` (lines 123-129). That is why it must be inside the router.
- **LanguageProvider**: `useLanguage()` → `{ language, changeLanguage }`, synced with i18next's `languageChanged` event. Languages are en, es and fr.
- **Page- and feature-level providers** (not global):
  - `HomePageProvider` (`hooks/useHomePageContext`) in `pages/Home/index.tsx`.
  - `VotingContextProvider` and `ClassicAppealProvider` in `pages/Cases/CaseDetails/index.tsx:99-100`.
  - A local `OpenContext` for the mobile menu in `layout/Header/MobileHeader.tsx`.
  - `pages/GetPnk/WalletProvider.tsx` sets up a **second, nested** `WagmiProvider` plus `createAppKit` (mainnet network, LiFi `useSyncWagmiConfig`) just for the LiFi swap widget.

All paths are under `/home/agentops/dev/kleros/kleros-v2/web/`. The current branch is `feature/shutter-reveal-justification/shutter-reveal-justification-001`.

## 1. Entry and boot

- **`src/index.html`**
  - Sets meta tags and the title "Kleros · Court".
  - An inline `<head>` script reads `localStorage.theme`. If it is not `"light"`, it sets the html background to `#1B003F` so dark-mode users don't see a white flash.
  - `<div id="app">` is the mount point, loaded with `<script type="module" src="index.tsx">`.
  - Vite's `root` is `src`, so this html file is the Vite entry.
- **`src/index.tsx`** runs `Modal.setAppElement(#app)` (react-modal), then `createRoot(#app).render(<React.StrictMode><HashRouter><App/></HashRouter></React.StrictMode>)`.
  - Routing uses a **HashRouter**, so URLs look like `/#/cases/...`. Playwright's baseURL is `http://localhost:5173/#`.
- **`src/app.tsx`** does several things when it is imported:
  - Imports CSS: `react-loading-skeleton` and `react-toastify`.
  - `import "./i18n"` initialises i18next.
  - Importing `./utils/sentry` runs `Sentry.init` and exports `SentryRoutes` (`withSentryReactRouterV6Routing(Routes)`).
  - Importing `context/Web3Provider` pulls in `src/config/wagmi.ts`, which at module load:
    - creates the `WagmiAdapter`;
    - calls `configureSDK` for `@kleros/kleros-sdk`;
    - calls `createAppKit` (Reown modal).
  - It **throws** at load time if `WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID` is missing (`wagmi.ts:19`) or `ALCHEMY_API_KEY` is missing (`config/rpc.ts:18`).
- **Render order:** providers (lines 42-50) → `SentryRoutes` (line 51) → `Layout` at path `/` (line 52) → the matched page in `<Suspense fallback={<Loader 48px/>}>`.
- **Build metadata:** `src/generatedGitInfo.json` (version and git hash) is imported by `consts/index.ts`. It is produced by `scripts/gitInfo.js`, which runs via `scripts/generateBuildInfo.sh` only in `build-netlify`. It is gitignored and not present in this checkout, so run it before a local start.

## 2. Provider stack (`src/app.tsx:42-136`)

```
<React.StrictMode>                                  index.tsx
 └ <HashRouter>                                      index.tsx
   └ <StyledComponentsProvider>                      context/StyledComponentsProvider.tsx
     │  = styled ThemeProvider (light/dark) > ToggleThemeProvider (hooks/useToggleThemeContext) > <GlobalStyle/>
     └ <ErrorBoundary FallbackComponent=ErrorFallback>   react-error-boundary; components/ErrorFallback.tsx
       └ <Web3Provider>                              context/Web3Provider.tsx  (WagmiProvider)
         └ <QueryClientProvider>                     context/QueryClientProvider.tsx (TanStack, default QueryClient)
           └ <GraphqlBatcherProvider>                context/GraphqlBatcher.tsx
             └ <AtlasProvider>                       context/AtlasProvider.tsx (@kleros/kleros-app)
               └ <IsListProvider>                    context/IsListProvider.tsx
                 └ <NewDisputeProvider>              context/NewDisputeContext.tsx
                   └ <LanguageProvider>              context/LanguageProvider.tsx
                     └ <SentryRoutes>
                       └ <Route "/" element=<Layout/>>   layout/index.tsx
                           └ OverlayScrollContext.Provider   (context/OverlayScrollContext.tsx)
                              └ OverlayScrollbars > Header / ToastContainer / <Outlet/> / Footer
```

What each provider gives the app:
- **StyledComponentsProvider**
  - Theme is kept in localStorage under `"theme"` (default `"dark"`) via `hooks/useLocalStorage`.
  - Supplies `lightTheme`/`darkTheme` from `styles/themes.ts` and `useToggleTheme()` → `[theme, toggleTheme]`.
  - Renders `GlobalStyle` (`styles/global-style.ts`), which also sets the toastify CSS variables, skeleton colours, the ReactModal overlay z-index (10000) and base typography (Open Sans).
- **ErrorBoundary** sits outside `Layout`, so a crash shows the full-page `ErrorFallback` with no header or footer. It is still themed.
- **Web3Provider**
  - Wraps `WagmiProvider` with `wagmiAdapter.wagmiConfig`.
  - Exposes `window._setupMockAccount(addrOrPk, features)` for Playwright. It builds a mock-connector adapter (`config/wagmi.ts:56` `createMockAdapter`), registers it with `appKit.addAdapter`, and swaps the config. It is used by `src/tests/e2e/fixtures/wallet.ts:28-32`.
- **QueryClientProvider** is one module-level `new QueryClient()` with defaults. It sits inside `WagmiProvider`, which is the order wagmi v2 expects.
- **GraphqlBatcherProvider**
  - `useGraphqlBatcher()` → `{ graphqlBatcher }`, built on `@yornaath/batshit` (100 ms window, max batch 5) and `@graphql-tools/batch-execute`.
  - Two executors: `core` → `getGraphqlUrl(false)` and `dtr` (Dispute Template Registry) → `getGraphqlUrl(true)`. A query is routed by its `isDisputeTemplate` flag.
  - Requests go through `graphql-request`, with a debounced error toast on failure.
  - Typical use: `useQuery({ queryFn: () => graphqlBatcher.fetch({ id, document, variables }) })` with a `graphql()` document from the generated `src/graphql`. Example: `src/hooks/queries/useCourtPolicyURI.ts`.
- **AtlasProvider** wraps `_AtlasProvider` from `@kleros/kleros-app` with:
  - `{ uri: REACT_APP_ATLAS_URI, signupProduct: CourtV2, ipfsProduct: CourtV2, wagmiConfig: useConfig() }`.
  - It gives auth/SIWE, email/user settings and IPFS upload through `useAtlasProvider()`. For example, `pages/Resolver/index.tsx` reads `isVerified`, and `components/EnsureAuth` uses it.
- **IsListProvider**: `useIsList()` → `{ isList, setIsList }`, the list-vs-grid toggle for case cards, kept in localStorage under `"isList"`.
- **NewDisputeProvider**
  - `useNewDisputeContext()` holds the Resolver (case-creation) wizard state: `disputeData`, a derived `disputeTemplate` (stamps `klerosCoreAddress[DEFAULT_CHAIN.id]`), batch creation / `batchSize`, `selectedFeatures`, and submitting/uploading flags.
